item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "9feafa1fe1b6725caa35d05788282b51e3143461fc2fe35642ec32a0c9a10f78",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "Maps a real square matrix A and a vector v to the matrix-vector product Av.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the flux as multiplication by the specified constant two-by-two matrix.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "An abbreviation for LocalDef007 with exactly the same arguments.",
      "effect_on_target": "The hypothesis requires four scalar partial derivatives at the selected point and the two equations specified in D007.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "An abbreviation for LocalDef006 for vectors indexed by Fin m.",
      "effect_on_target": "The conclusion is the derivative-existence and zero-sum predicate of D006 with m = 2.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "For real K and rho, forms the matrix A = [[0, K], [rho⁻¹, 0]], with row and column indices 0 and 1.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the flux to F(v₀,v₁) = (K v₁, rho⁻¹ v₀).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "Forms q(x,t) = (pressure(x,t), velocity(x,t)) as a function from Fin 2 to the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "The first state component is pressure and the second is velocity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "There exist vectors qt and fluxx such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative qt at t, ξ ↦ flux(q(ξ,t)) has derivative fluxx at x, and qt + fluxx = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires actual vector derivative witnesses for the time slice of the state and the spatial slice of its flux, with componentwise zero sum.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "LocalDef007",
      "meaning": "There exist real pt, px, ut, ux giving, respectively, the time and space derivatives of pressure and velocity at (x,t), and satisfying pt + bulkModulus·ux = 0 and ut + density⁻¹·px = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies all four scalar derivative-existence assumptions and both scalar differential equations at the same point.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "LocalDef008",
      "meaning": "For every index type, real scalar multiplication on real-valued functions on that type is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the continuous scalar multiplication structure needed for the vector-valued derivative predicates; it is not an extra hypothesis on pressure or velocity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "LocalDef009",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication on the reals is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the scalar derivative predicates without adding an assumption on the input functions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin n is the type of natural-number indices less than n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fin 2 supplies precisely the two component indices 0 and 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates all elements of Fin n using finRange n, with completeness and no duplicates.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the matrix-vector sum range over both indices 0 and 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural-number type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the dimension parameter 2 and the sizes used in finite vector construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Ne",
      "meaning": "Ne a b means that a = b is false.",
      "effect_on_target": "The first hypothesis is density ≠ 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Extracts the value interpreting a natural-number literal in the specified type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets 0 as real zero and 2 as the natural-number dimension.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real-number type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both independent variables, both field values, and both coefficients are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "Supplies the real additive zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the zero in the nonzero-density assumption, matrix entries, and scalar equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 using a type's specified zero element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects literal zero to real zero and, where required, function-space zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "instOfNatNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number literal n as n itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the vector dimension is exactly 2.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "DFunLike.coe",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying function from a function-like object.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows the matrix-construction equivalence to be applied as a function, without changing its entries.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "Equiv",
      "meaning": "A bijective equivalence between two types, with forward and inverse functions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Packages the identity identification between a two-index function and a matrix.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "Equiv.instEquivLike",
      "meaning": "Uses an equivalence's forward and inverse functions as its equivalence-like structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes Matrix.of act through its forward function.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "EquivLike.toFunLike",
      "meaning": "Retains the forward function of an equivalence-like object as a function-like coercion.",
      "effect_on_target": "Permits application of Matrix.of to the listed rows.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A finite enumeration of all elements of a type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports finite summation in matrix-vector multiplication; the target uses the fixed enumeration of Fin 2.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "Inv.inv",
      "meaning": "Extracts a type's unary inverse operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Applies real inversion to density in the matrix and scalar hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "Matrix",
      "meaning": "A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entries in α is a function m → n → α.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coefficient matrix is a real-valued function of two Fin 2 indices.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "Matrix.mulVec",
      "meaning": "The i-th component of Mv is the dot product of row i with v, namely the sum over j of M(i,j)v(j).",
      "effect_on_target": "Computes the two flux components as bulkModulus times velocity and density⁻¹ times pressure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "Matrix.of",
      "meaning": "The identity equivalence from two-index functions to matrices.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the specified arrangement of entries; it does not transpose or transform the matrix.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "Matrix.vecCons",
      "meaning": "Prepends a head component to a finite vector, placing the head at index 0 and shifting the tail.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the ordering of the state components and all matrix rows and entries.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "Matrix.vecEmpty",
      "meaning": "The unique function from the empty type Fin 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Terminates the finite vectors used to construct the two-component state and two-by-two matrix.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the operations and weaker ring structure of a nonunital commutative ring while dropping the associativity requirement from the interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the structure path providing ordinary real arithmetic to matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Projects the underlying nonunital nonassociative ring structure, forgetting the commutativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real operations used in the flux computation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, multiplication, zero, and distributivity while forgetting additive inverses from the interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the algebraic structure required by Matrix.mulVec without altering real arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital commutative ring from its normed structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited real ring operations for the finite flux sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, metric, and ring operations while forgetting the multiplicative-unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real normed ring instance to the weaker structure used for matrix multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "Real.instInv",
      "meaning": "Supplies real multiplicative inversion, with the totalized convention 0⁻¹ = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Under density ≠ 0, density⁻¹ is the ordinary reciprocal 1/density.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Combines the real normed additive group and real commutative ring into a normed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the ordinary compatible real arithmetic and norm used by the matrix and analytic structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "All four scalar derivative assertions and both equations hold together; all three vector conclusion assertions also hold together.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Obtains a nontrivially normed field from a densely normed field, retaining its normed field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real scalar-field structure required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Projects the underlying semiring structure of a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited real semiring operations for scalar and function-space module instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The scalar equations are exact real equalities and the vector zero-sum assertion is equality of functions, hence equality at both indices.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over a witness satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Binds the four real derivative witnesses in the hypothesis and the two vector derivative witnesses in the conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains a field's nonnegative-operation interface, including its multiplication, inversion, division, and semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real scalar structure without changing operations or imposing a sign restriction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition operation supplied for the operand and result types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Means ordinary addition in the scalar equations and pointwise vector addition in the conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplication operation supplied for the operand and result types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Means real multiplication in the products bulkModulus·ux and density⁻¹·px.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "Asserts that a function of one scalar variable has the specified derivative at the specified point, using the neighborhood filter of that point and a fixed base point.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires ordinary derivatives of the displayed real-variable slices, including vector-valued slices with product topology; these are not merely formal derivative symbols or derivatives restricted to a subset.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Projects the additive commutative monoid of a nonunital nonassociative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides addition and zero for finite sums and associated module structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplication commutativity from a nonunital seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real additive and metric structures used in forming derivative codomains.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the compatible additive analytic structure used by real normed spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Projects a nonunital semiring to its weaker structure without an associativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves ordinary addition and multiplication along a real algebraic instance path.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Projects the normed field underlying a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the compatible real field and norm used by scalar differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed commutative ring's norm, ring operations, and induced pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real seminormed structure without changing its topology or arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the field structure of a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real field operations for the scalar module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Regards a normed field as a normed vector space over itself, with multiplication as scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes scalar-valued derivatives use the usual real vector-space structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying module of a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real-linear structure needed in HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "Gives a function space I → β the module structure induced pointwise by the module structure on β.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the state and derivative vectors ordinary real vectors with coordinatewise scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Gives a function space the pointwise additive commutative group structure of its values.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides vector addition and subtraction for the vector derivative predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Pi.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Defines function addition by (f + g)(i) = f(i) + g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "The equation qt + fluxx = 0 is the pair of equations qt(i) + fluxx(i) = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Pi.instZero",
      "meaning": "Defines the zero function by assigning zero to every index.",
      "effect_on_target": "The conclusion's zero vector is (0,0).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "The product topology on a function space, formed from the topologies induced by all coordinate evaluations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector derivatives take values in the usual finite product topology on R².",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the usual real distance to the topology used in derivative limits.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Equips the real normed field with the property that norms occur between any two positive real bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the nontrivial normed scalar field required by differentiation, with no extra quantified hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Supplies ordinary real addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines all scalar sums and the values of pointwise vector sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar derivative codomain and the component groups underlying vector derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "Supplies ordinary real multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines coefficient products, matrix-vector products, and real scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "The ring structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the ordinary real arithmetic and induced module structures used in the proposition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "Combines the real field and normed additive group into the usual normed field, including reciprocal cancellation for nonzero elements and inverse zero equal to zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the ordinary real analytic setting and the field interpretation of density⁻¹.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Uses distance d(x,y) = |x − y| on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures real neighborhoods and derivative limits have their ordinary metric meaning.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Ring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Projects the semiring structure underlying a ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real semiring operations for module construction without changing the underlying real domain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains the semiring, inversion, and division operations of a semifield while forgetting multiplicative commutativity from the interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the instance path supporting real scalar modules; it introduces no new assumption.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, pseudometric, and commutative ring operations while forgetting the multiplicative-unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real analytic structure used to obtain a seminormed additive group.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Projects a semiring to its underlying nonunital semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the same real addition, multiplication, and zero in weaker algebraic interfaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology associated with a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the usual real topology from its metric uniform structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Uses a type's addition as heterogeneous-notation addition with identical operand and result types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves displayed sums to ordinary scalar or pointwise vector addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Uses a type's multiplication as heterogeneous-notation multiplication with identical operand and result types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves displayed coefficient products to real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Projects an additive commutative monoid to its additive monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the scalar-action instance hierarchy while preserving addition and zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "ContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Asserts joint continuity of the scalar multiplication map (a,v) ↦ a • v.",
      "effect_on_target": "Is a structural prerequisite for the derivative codomains, supplied for real scalars and real-valued vectors by D008 and D009.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative action from an action distributing over addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the scalar action underlying the real module and its continuity requirement.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action from a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects real vector-space scalar multiplication to the action structure used by ContinuousSMul.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "Monoid.toSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Projects a monoid to its associative multiplication structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the scalar action hierarchy using the same real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative monoid from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the monoid of real scalars acting on the derivative codomains.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "MulAction.toSemigroupAction",
      "meaning": "Projects a monoid action to its semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real scalar action while passing to the interface exposing scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed field's norm, commutative ring, and metric structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides compatible normed ring structures for real arithmetic and scalar continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "Pi.instSMul",
      "meaning": "Defines scalar multiplication on functions pointwise: (a • f)(i) = a • f(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative vectors use ordinary coordinatewise real scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "SemigroupAction.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from a semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Exposes the same scalar operation used in the derivative and continuous-scalar-multiplication structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Projects a seminormed commutative ring to a seminormed ring, retaining its norm and operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of the real pseudometric without altering the topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric space underlying a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the compatible topology used for continuity of real scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
